markdown.markdown:
What is this website for?

Mathematics is a hard but useful subject for the modern world especially. This website is to continue my mathematics education and to offer mathematical service. I gained a PhD from the University of Warwick and I do not want to lose all my abilities (that I may or may not have developed)!

Services

I offer the following services

  • mathematics tutoring and resources up to university and advice and support on studying mathematics
  • consulting on statistics, data analysis and coding

If you might be interested in this please contact and we can see if I am a good fit for you.

Research and Essays

In terms of my research I have a PhD thesis titled 'Data Driven Analysis and Modelling of the Wealth Distribution'. Here I analysed several mathematical models that generates key features of the wealth distribution. I also analysed empirically the wealth distribution using real world data. I have one published paper on this. Following my PhD I have continued researching on similar topics particularly relating to heavy-tailed distributions. I also have interest in macroeconomics in general and on limits to growth. On these interests I have produced several pre-prints. I aim to continue research as you never know what you could produce?!

I also have attempted writing some popular maths essays. Of course in this I am not saying anything new in general but just sharing some things I find interesting.

Tutoring

For tutoring I aim to share lots of resources that I have created or will create with the help of AI and LaTex. I will start at school level (GCSE or below in the UK) as I see a gap in the market for 'clean' looking worksheets with solutions!

AI

I want to discuss briefly AI. There are purists who will say do not use it at all. In some sense I agree however it can be useful to speed things up, find mistakes and most importantly cut down the time to produce things. How I use it will develop over time as it is a new and developing technology. Full disclosure: I have used AI (mainly google gemini) to help create this website, write the essays and in some recent research. Did I say for example: produce an essay on $x$? NO!! I did more work than that! However, how I use it will change over time as for example I wish to not sound too much like a corporate American (nothing against them) and keep my own imperfect voice.

Support and Contact

If you found anything useful here and would like to support the ongoing development of this website you can leave a contribution via Stripe.
